locations.note: Hourglass: Doha half-buried in sand after the storms, and Stadium, its arena. Multiplayer maps.
Orbital: a rocket launch at the spaceport that can be shot down mid-count. A multiplayer map.
Kaleidoscope: the glass towers of Songdo, a multiplayer map.
Manifest: the container terminal on Brani Island, a multiplayer map.
Discarded: the ship-breaking beach at Alang, a multiplayer map.
Breakaway: an oil rig and research station on the ice of Queen Maud Land, the largest map in the series.
Renewal: a green wall of farmland holding back the desert, a multiplayer map.
Exposure: a cliffside base in the Canadian Rockies, a Season 1 map.
Stranded: a tanker wrecked in the Panama Canal, a Season 2 map.
Spearhead: two megafactories in the Swedish forest, a Season 3 map.
Flashpoint: the deserts of northern South Africa, a Season 4 map.
Reclaimed: an abandoned factory in the Czech Republic, a Season 5 map.
Redacted: a hidden research facility in the Hebrides, a Season 6 map.
Haven: abandoned farmland in Chile, a Season 7 map.
Portal: Arica Harbor from Bad Company 2.
Portal: Valparaíso from Bad Company 2.
Portal: Battle of the Bulge from Battlefield 1942.
Portal: El Alamein from Battlefield 1942.
Portal: Caspian Border from Battlefield 3.
Portal: Noshahr Canals from Battlefield 3.
